# harmoniq Provider

Manages [Harmoniq](https://github.com/TrivioQ/Harmoniq) workspaces, host apps, environments, modules, API keys, webhooks, alert rules and approval policies.

Authenticate with an **organization API key** with the `admin` scope (Organization → API keys). It can create and delete the organization's workspaces and issue workspace API keys. A workspace key with the `admin` scope manages everything inside its workspace except workspaces and API keys.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    harmoniq = {
      source  = "harmoniq-dev/harmoniq"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# Or set HARMONIQ_REGISTRY_URL and HARMONIQ_API_KEY.
provider "harmoniq" {
  registry_url = "https://registry.acme.dev"
  api_key      = var.harmoniq_org_key # an organization key with the admin scope
}

variable "harmoniq_org_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key (`hq_org_…` or `hq_…`). Defaults to `HARMONIQ_API_KEY`.
- `registry_url` (String) Registry URL, e.g. `https://registry.acme.dev`. Defaults to `HARMONIQ_REGISTRY_URL`.
